chapterBreakdown.gentle:
Once recurring patterns are visible, the book can widen the frame again. The chapter turns to the sources of noise and gathers different contributors into one broader view.

That matters because no single contributor is enough to explain the whole picture. Noise has to be understood through a broader map of contributors.

Hard depth sharpens the point. The chapter is not simply naming more sources. It is synthesizing them into one account without letting any one contributor swallow the rest.

The chapter keeps one strict limit visible. A wider source map can improve diagnosis, but it does not become a final key or a promise of total mastery.

This is what changes after the chapter on patterns. The reader now looks not only at one recurring form of variation but at how multiple contributors fit together.

chapterBreakdown.direct:
The chapter builds a broader source map for noise. It argues that multiple contributors need to be seen together instead of one by one.

That matters because the earlier chapters have introduced different contributors to variation that cannot be reduced to a single cause without losing accuracy.

This is the harder distinction it wants to preserve. The synthesis is plural and organizing without becoming a ranked taxonomy, a one-cause story, or a final explanation.

The limit remains essential. The chapter clarifies the field without claiming the complexity of noise has been conquered.

That is what sets up the next move. After the source field is gathered into one view, the book can present a disciplined response in the mediating assessments protocol.
chapterBreakdown.competitive:
The chapter stops chasing one culprit and opens the whole field map.

That matters because the noise picture has too many engines to fit under one crown, and the earlier chapters have left those engines spread across the floor.

This is where the chapter gets sharp. It brings the engines onto one board without turning the board into a throne room or a magic key.

The discipline stays tight. No ranked scoreboard shows up, and no emperor-engine is announced.

That is what earns the next step. Once the field is mapped, the book can open the repair kit in the mediating assessments protocol.
